final_design.explanation:
Case-study starting design for photoredox batch-to-flow translation.

Closed-loop v2: Diagnosis: conversion is below target (45.0%). Next run: Refine for kinetic_underconversion. residence_time_min: 10.0 -> 38.515; flow_rate_mL_min: 0.2 -> 0.05193. Increase in-channel residence time before changing chemistry because conversion is below target.

Closed-loop v3: Diagnosis: conversion is acceptable but yield/selectivity is not; solids, precipitation, or clogging were observed; pressure drift indicates unstable hydraulic operation. Next run: Refine for selectivity_loss, solubility_or_fouling, pressure_instability, experiment_calibrated_kinetics. residence_time_min: 32.738 -> 68.515; flow_rate_mL_min: 0.06109 -> 0.02919; temperature_C: 30.0 -> 40.0; concentration_M: 0.07 -> 0.1; BPR_bar: 7.0 -> 5.0; tubing_ID_mm: 1.0 -> 0.8; residence_time_in_channel_min: None -> 68.515; residence_time_inlet_min: None -> 68.515; residence_time_basis: None -> in-channel total actual flow. Use evidence-calibrated residence times from the experimental campaign instead of the original intensification estimate. Reduce thermal/over-reaction stress because conversion is acceptable but selectivity or yield is poor. Reduce concentration and add filtration/dissolution controls because pressure drift or solids were observed. Stabilize hydraulic operation before further intensification.

Closed-loop v4: Experimental feedback meets the current target; use the next cycle for reproducibility confirmation. Next run: Refine for target confirmation. no major numeric change. Use evidence-calibrated residence times from the experimental campaign instead of the original intensification estimate. Design met the target yield; confirm reproducibility before scale-up.
